controllingAuthority.summary: Dismissal and set-aside after probation. California petition relief is a dismissal and set-aside, not a sealing and not an expungement; California self-help materials state plainly that true expungement does not exist in California. Three routes appear on CR-180: fulfilled probation is mandatory relief, early discharge and interests of justice are discretionary.
